abstract: Maintains architectural space allocations, fixed seating capacities, and facilities standby charges
system_message:
You are the Facilities operations director (FAC). Your business responsibilities include maintaining architectural space allocations, fixed seating capacities, and facilities standby charges, as well as tracking backup power reserves across candidate venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Backup power reserves（PWR）
information_points.content:
FAC-PWR-RY8：At Kelvin River Conference Hub, on-site diesel generator reserves support a continuous generator autonomy duration of 24 h under full electrical load without refueling.
FAC-PWR-QTC：Merchant City Exhibition Hall maintains on-site diesel generator fuel tanks providing a generator autonomy duration of 48 h under full electrical load.
FAC-PWR-SDX：For Clyde Waterfront Congress Centre, emergency engineering assessments indicate a generator autonomy duration of 36 h of continuous backup power run-time under full electrical load without refueling.

information_points.title: Maintains architectural space allocations, fixed seating capacities, and facilities standby charges（SPACE）
information_points.content:
FAC-SPACE-3QS：According to the architectural floor plan schedule, Kelvin River Conference Hub provides a main plenary seating capacity of 1400 seats in its primary convention auditorium in a fixed theater configuration, with a daily facilities standby fee of 3200 GBP covering facility management, HVAC, and power distribution standby services.
FAC-SPACE-TXU：For Clyde Waterfront Congress Centre, the licensed fixed audience seating capacity in the primary convention auditorium under a fixed theater configuration provides a main plenary seating capacity of 1250 seats, while the fixed daily cost for dedicated facility management, HVAC, and power distribution standby crew across all hired halls results in a daily facilities standby fee of 5200 GBP.
FAC-SPACE-T4B：Merchant City Exhibition Hall features a main plenary seating capacity of 1050 seats in its primary convention auditorium in a fixed theater configuration, and incurs a daily facilities standby fee of 4500 GBP for full event day operations across all hired halls.
